title: Manga 'Isekai Kuimetsu no Same' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Kuboken 's Isekai Kuimetsu no Same ( Killer Shark in Another World ) on Thursday, revealing staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.

Staff Director: Shigeru Fukase ( Shin Shinka no Mi: Shiranai Uchi ni Kachigumi Jinsei ) Series Composition, Script: Shigeru Murakoshi ( Ballpark de Tsukamaete! ) Character Design: Sou Ikuyama ( Watashi wo Tabetai, Hitodenashi ) Shark Design: Iroha Mitsuki ( Shin Shinka no Mi: Shiranai Uchi ni Kachigumi Jinsei character design) Music: Keiji Inai ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) Production: Infinite Studio: Studio Lings

Kuboken began serializing the fantasy comedy manga in Comic Valkyrie in October 2020. Kill Time Communication published the 12th volume on July 8.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the series in English in February 2024. The seventh volume was released on July 7, with the eighth volume scheduled for a January 2027 release.

Synopsis Everyone thought Shiromi Lovecut-Toothrough was the worst summoner in the world. But after she summons Sharkiller, a creature capable of transforming into Hollywood's most ferocious B-movie sharks, nobody's laughing now! In fact, they're running for their lives! With her bloodthirsty buddy chomping at the bit to kill everyone in sight, can Shiromi defeat the Demon King and end his reign of terror? Or maybe the realm would be better off if she didn't...?

title: Netflix’s Solo Leveling Hit With a Major Production Shake-Up Barely Two Episodes In
content:
Netflix’s Solo Leveling live-action faces a major staff change just two episodes into filming, potentially affecting the rest of the production. When the project was first announced, it was revealed that Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo would co-direct the series. The duo already had an established working relationship, having previously collaborated on the 2019 action-adventure film Ashfall . The staff looked promising, and recent updates suggested that production had been progressing smoothly. However, a recent report from South Korean publication OSEN has revealed the production’s first major shake-up. Director Lee Haejun has stepped down from the series after just two episodes of filming were completed.

According to the report, Han Dongwook will replace him and work alongside Kim Byung-seo as co-director for the remainder of the series. OSEN also reported that the decision involved the production committee , Netflix, and Lee Haejun, with all parties mutually agreeing to his departure. The change was reportedly made amicably rather than due to any conflict or differences in interest. While it is a good sign that production is continuing, fans may still feel disappointed, especially given the established working dynamic between Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo.

Netflix’s Solo Leveling Director Lee Haejun Steps Down After Just Two Episodes of Filming

While it is concerning that the series’ lead director has stepped down midway through production, another update from a South Korean publication suggests that these changes may have been planned rather than sudden. According to Newsen , which received an update from the production team itself, the series is one of the projects where different directors handle individual episodes. Lee Haejun directed the first two episodes, while the remaining episodes will be handled by Kim Byung-seo and Han Dongwook. While the accuracy of this explanation remains unclear, it is good news that filming for the project is still progressing.

The main point for fans to focus on is whether Han Dongwook will be a suitable replacement for Lee Haejun. His track record suggests that he could be a good choice. Although Dongwook has not previously worked as a lead director, he has considerable experience with series that feature crime thrillers and romance. This bodes well for Solo Leveling , especially since the series appears to be taking the latter element more seriously. Actress Han Sohee, who plays Cha Hae-in, recently discussed how she is approaching the role in an interview. Considering the focus on Cha Hae-in so early in the series , it does seem that the adaptation is aiming for a more romantic, essentially K-drama-like approach.

However, that doesn’t mean the series will be completely deprived of action. Lead star Byeon Woo-seok, who will play the scene-stealing Sung Jinwoo, commented on how adventurous his experience performing the action sequences in the live-action series has been. All in all, despite the recent staff shake-up in Netflix’s Solo Leveling , it is clear that production is moving forward . With two episodes confirmed to have been filmed, the remaining five could also be completed soon, allowing the series to stay on track for its rumored 2028 release date.

What do you think about the latest update on Netflix’s Solo Leveling live-action series? Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

title: kuboken's Killer Shark in Another World Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
Kadokawa announced on Friday kuboken 's Killer Shark in Another World ( Isekai Kuimetsu no Same ) manga will get a television anime adaptation.

Shige Fukase ( Hamidashi Creative ; episode director for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime , Vinland Saga ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings . Shigeru Murakoshi ( Snowball Earth , Dark Gathering , I Parry Everything ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Nozomi Ikuyama ( This Monster Wants to Eat Me , The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess ) is designing the characters. Iroha Mizuki is in charge of shark design, and Keiji Inai ( Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? franchise) is composing the music. Infinite is producing the series.

Everyone thought Shiromi Lovecut-Toothrough was the worst summoner in the world. But after she summons Sharkiller, a creature capable of transforming into Hollywood's most ferocious B-movie sharks, nobody's laughing now! In fact, they're running for their lives! With her bloodthirsty buddy chomping at the bit to kill everyone in sight, can Shiromi defeat the Demon King and end his reign of terror? Or maybe the realm would be better off if she didn't...?

kuboken launched the manga in Kill Time Communication 's Comic Valkyrie magazine in October 2020. Kill Time Communication published the 12th compiled volume on July 8.

title: Fool Night Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga revealed three more cast members on Thursday.

Previously announced cast members include:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

• Aya Endō as Saeko Kanaeno

• Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi

• Shion Wakayama as Sumi Matsuno

• The late Hiroshi Tsuchida as Ken Hikasa

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Nishi

• Sayaka Senbongi as Meg Okumura

• Yumiko Kobayashi as Ivy

Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) directed the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) wrote the scripts. Robert Satō designed the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) composed the music.

Other staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Ryō Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryō Kikuchi

• Art Director: Maki Takano (J.C. Staff)

• Color Design: Jin Hibino

• Director of Photography: Mana Ishikawa (animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (Tera Effect), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Directors: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editing Room)

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

The band Tempalay performs the opening theme song "Shake! spit out," and Nowlu performs the ending theme song "Iki" (Breath).

Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan will ship the manga's 14th compiled book volume on November 30. The manga has crossed one million copies in circulation worldwide as of this month.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Special Promo Video
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo ), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, revealed on Thursday a new special promotional video. The video previews both the opening and ending theme songs.

The anime will debut on January 4 on TV Tokyo at 26:00 JST (effectively January 5 at 2:00 a.m. JST), then on January 9 on BS Asahi at 25:00 JST (effectively January 10 at 1:00 a.m. JST).

The anime will star:

• Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

• Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

• Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

• Tōru Furusawa as Hideo Tanimura

• Kōsuke Echigoya as Tomio Tomii

• Nobuo Tobita as Taizō

• Hiroshi Naka as Kyōichi Koizumi

• Kyō Yaoya as Kinue Arakawa

• Hiroko Ushida as Noriko Mitani

• Kenji Yamauchi as Mantarō Kyōgoku

• Ken Uo as Tōjin Tōyama

• Daisuke Ono as Ichirō Dan

• Yasuaki Takumi as Isamu Kinjō

• Akane Fujita as Mariko Niki

• Tomokazu Seki as Seiichi Okaboshi

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

Additional staff members include:

• Art Director: Makoto Dobashi

• Color Design: Megumi Takahashi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Muneaki Satō

• Editing: Yumiko Nakaba (Okayasu Promotions)

• Sound Director: Yasuyuki Urakami

• Sound Production: Audio Planning U

• Music: Hayato Matsuo

• Music Production: IMAGINE

Yui Makino performs the opening theme song "Promise Me," and three-piece band Skoop on Somebody will perform the ending theme song "Akashi" (Proof).

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th compiled book volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014. Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials. The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: Arcanadea TV Anime Casts M.A.O, Ai Kakuma
content:
The staff for the television anime of Kotobukiya 's Arcanadea bishōjo plastic model series revealed two more cast members on Thursday. Both cast members (character name romanizations below are not confirmed) are reprising their roles from previous works in the franchise.

M.A.O as Elmeda

Ai Kakuma as Sofiella

The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on TV Asahi and 24 total stations across Japan in the NUMAnimation programming block. The anime will also air on BS Asahi .

Kaede Hondo will continue to voice the character Lumitea in the anime. Hondo already voices the character in the short video version of the franchise's four-panel manga titled YuruCanadea ( YuruCana in short).

The anime will also star:

• Miho Okasaki as Velretta

• Rina Hidaka as Yukumo

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Shōgo Kuga

• Konomi Inagaki as Kaho Asagi

• Mai Kanno as Rin Kirinoue

• Moka Kanzaki as Ghi

Kotobukiya is credited with the original work. Keiichirō Kawaguchi ( Sket Dance , Spy Classroom , Psychic Squad ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab . Atsuhiro Tomioka ( Pokémon XY , Trinity Blood , Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest ) is overseeing the series scripts. Kumoha Arakawa (name romanization not confirmed) is adapting necömi 's original character designs for animation. Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ) and Yūki Furuhashi ( My Hero Academia: Vigilantes ) are composing the music.

The "sci-fi x fantasy" franchise takes place in the near future, where the world experienced rapid technological development thanks to a new energy called "Arcana Particles" that was discovered by Eden Industries. The new technology includes the largest virtual space server called Eden. The VRMMO " ARCANADEA " is a game people can play within the Eden server, and features a fantasy world. After an explosion occurred at Eden Industries one night during the maintenance of Eden, the world changed, including abnormal weather, communication issues, strange disappearances, and people gaining increased physical abilities.

The franchise has inspired not just plastic models but also various other merchandise and a series of ASMR CDs. The franchise's official website also publishes a four-panel manga .

The franchise launched in December 2021 and has shipped over 500,000 figures as of June 2025.

title: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess TV Anime Reveals January 1 Debut in Video
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Kotoko and artist Kaname Hanamiya 's The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me ( Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Nazeka Last Boss О̄jisama ni Shūchaku Sareteimasu ) manga revealed the show's main promotional video on Thursday, alongside the announcement of the show's debut on January 1.

The anime will debut on January 1 at 10:30 p.m. on AT-X . The series will then air on Tokyo MX , BS NTV , and CBC TV on January 8. The series will stream on services such as d Anime Store , ABEMA , and more in Japan starting on January 1 at 25:00 (effectively January 2 at 1:00 a.m.).

Additionally, the website revealed one more cast member, the theme song artists, and the main visual on Thursday.

Yoshitsugu Matsuoka will voice Richard (pictured above with white hair) in the series.

REIRIE performs the opening theme song "Yorore Yoen," and SERRA performs the ending theme song "Silhouette Letter."

The anime stars:

• Haruka Shiraishi as Celine

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Wilfred

• Shunichi Toki as Lewis

• Fūka Izumi as Adele

Naoyuki Kuzuya ( Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time ) is directing the anime at Studio Lings with Shūsaku Katо̄ as the assistant director. Mitsutaka Hirota ( Edens Zero ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Infinite is producing.

Additional staff members include:

• Character Designer: Nozomi Ikuyama, Fumino Kakihata, Yukiko Sekita

• Art Directors: Yuri Takagi, Keito Watanabe

• 3D Art Setting/3D Layout: Jishiro Shida

• Color Key Artist: Taeko Mizuno

• 2D Design: Suguru Shiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kenji Takehara

• Editing: Hitomi Sudō

• Sound Director: Ryōsuke Naya

• Sound Effects: Yuka Kazama

• Music: Tsubasa Itō

Media Do , NTT Docomo , Akatsuki Group, and MyAnimeList 's joint digital manga distribution service Manga Mirai is publishing the series in English ( until December), and it describes the story:

After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession..! Will Celine be able to find “peaceful happiness”? A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a Yandere.

Kotoko and Hanamiya launch the manga in April 2023. The sixth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on October 1. The series has over 70 million downloads.

title: Fool Night Releases Creditless Opening Featuring Tempalay Ahead of Today's Netflix Premiere
content:
FOOL NIGHT anime has released its creditless opening sequence ahead of the series’ worldwide Netflix premiere today (November 26, 2026). This is the first-ever joint project between studios SHAFT and SUNRISE, set to have a total of 12 episodes. Atsuyuki Yukawa directed the anime, which is his directorial debut. The anime features character designs by Robert Sato, with Jin Tanaka in charge of the series composition. The full staff includes:

• Director: Atsushi Yukawa

• Series Composition: Jin Tanaka

• Character Design: Robert Sato

• Assistant Director: Ryo Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryo Kikuchi

• Background Director: Maki Takano (J.C.STAFF)

• Color Design: Hitoshi Hibino

• Compositing Director: Mana Ishikawa (Animocaramel),Chiaki Tokuda (TERAEFFECT),Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Director: Naoki Yamamoto,Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editorial Office)

• Sound Director: Yota Tsuruoka

• Music: Tatsuya Kato

• Animation Production: SUNRISE×SHAFT

The main English dub cast was announced with the previous trailer, while the Japanese voice cast includes:

• Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

• Kiyomitsu Mizuchi as Jin Hiragishi

The opening song is “Shake! spit out” by Tempalay, and you can watch the video below.

Fool Night is a Japanese seinen manga written and illustrated by Kasumi Yasuda. The series began serialization in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020 and has released 13 volumes so far. It is also available in English through VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan Asia in Southeast Asia.

Set in a future where sunlight no longer reaches Earth and oxygen is running out, Fool Night follows a society that survives through “transfloration,” a process that turns humans into plants. The story centers on Toshiro Kamiya, a struggling young man who chooses this transformation but unexpectedly gains the ability to hear plants, leading him into work that connects humans with their transformed loved ones. The official introduction:

Official introduction:

Hurry up and turn me into a beautiful flower. Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival. In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration. A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope. Living… there isn’t a single thing fun about it. In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the “Spiriflor” — the plants that humans transform into. Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

title: Arcanadea' Unveils Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official website for a television anime adaptation of Arcanadea model series unveiled an additional cast pair on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027 on TV Asahi's NUMAnimation programming block and BS Asahi.

Voice actress Mao Ichimichi ( Sakamoto Days ) and Ai Kakuma ( Dragon Ball Daima ) are joining the cast as Elmeda and Sophiela, respectively.

Keiichirou Kawaguchi ( Spy Kyoushitsu ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab . Atsuhiro Tomioka ( Sentai Red Isekai de Boukensha ni Naru ) is handling series composition and Unu Shinkawa is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Boku no Hero Academia ) and Yuki Furuhashi ( Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia Illegals ) are composing the music.

necömi is credited as the original character designer.

Kotobukiya launched the sci-fi and fantasy-themed plastic model series in December 2021.

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Fool Night' Announced
content:
The official website of the Fool Night original net anime announced a supporting cast pair on Thursday. The anime adapting Kasumi Yasuda 's sci-fi drama manga is streaming worldwide exclusively on Netflix, with all 12 episodes released simultaneously on November 26.

Voice actors Nobuo Tobita ( Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ) and Akiko Yajima ( Hanyou no Yashahime: Sengoku Otogizoushi ) are joining in the anime as Ootaro Kyudai and Shiika Izumi, respectively.

Atsushi Yukawa ( Suzume no Tojimari episode director) helms the anime at Sunrise and Shaft . Jin Tanaka ( [Oshi no Ko] ) is handling the series composition, and Robert Satou is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katou ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Yasuda began serializing the sci-fi drama in Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan published the 13th volume on June 30.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2023 and released the tenth volume on September 15. The 11th volume is planned to go on sale on December 15.
